title: 第23章 前兆
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
云航镇坐落于群峰之间，因山岭地势原因，范围非常广，即便常驻人口有近十万，人均占地面积也很大。

    镇子分十八个区，八十一条正街，外加无数巷道、小径、青石板路，阡陌纵横。

    西街并非街道名，而是指‘西街区’，为宗门坊市核心区域之一，地下有一条三阶灵脉，是后来宗门移栽过来的。

    此区住户大多是青云宗门人的亲眷家属，甚至宗门弟子也到此置办宅院，以作更私密的住所，当然却以长老级的人物为主。

    像林语山那样先成为聂无极的妾室、再加入宗门的情况，相对还是比较少。

    毕竟宗门条条框框的规矩多，没那么自由，比如积分任务，只要入宗成为弟子，管你是峰主的妻妾，还是长老的儿女，都必须完成规定的积分任务。

    此刻，天空乌云密布，似乎要下雨了。

    齐子濯驾驭长虹落在一处府邸大门前。

    齐云溪背着苏牧，二人抬头看去，门额上没有牌匾，只在屋檐墙角刻有‘西街区、宝昌街六号’的指示字样。

    “便是这了。”

    齐子濯道了句，上前开锁推门而入，朝前引路，边介绍这宅子的大致情况。

    此处宅院为三进院子，占地面积将近四亩，共四十九间房，包含九间修炼室，布置的都是二阶聚灵阵，各处另设有隐匿、隔绝、防御、攻击等诸多阵法，也都是二阶。

    随着前行，大树、灌木、草坪、花圃、水井、池塘、假山、凉亭……一一映入眼帘，环境雅致清幽。

    齐云溪双目四顾，美眸闪烁亮光，嘴角噙着笑意，喜悦之情溢于言表。

    连苏牧内心都掀起波澜，不禁出声问：“齐老，这宅子租了几年？”

    作为青云宗门人，他对坊市各方面的情况多少也有些了解，知道西街区为长住区，至少十年起租。

    齐子濯偏头瞧去一眼，笑道：“买下来了，获得永久居住权。”

    闻言，苏牧嘴角微微抽搐，脑海里冒出来的第一个念头却是：买下这样一座宅子，还能剩多少家底？

    齐云溪倒是满心欢喜，睫毛颤动，暗道：买下来了才算真正的家。

    三人一路去到里院主楼主卧室。

    齐云溪小心将苏牧放在宽大的床榻上，扫视屋里环境，除了桌椅橱柜等家具，暂未添置其它物什用品，窗外一株老桂树的枝叶探到窗前，在午后的微风中轻轻摇曳，在窗台投下细碎的光斑。

    齐子濯跟着环视一圈，道：“需要用到什么，以后你们自己慢慢置办。”

    他摄来一把椅子坐在床前，嘴角浮现一丝笑意，似乎猜到苏牧的心理，说道：

    “不要短见，获得房产所有权，可以一直住下去，将来生儿育女，繁衍后代皆可在云航镇扎根，只要宗门不破，便有足够的安全保障。”

    这个道理苏牧自然懂，只是他自己的情况自己清楚，未必能在青云宗一直待下去，若是遇到解决不了的麻烦，铁定得跑路。

    他脸上闪过一丝尴尬，汗颜道：“齐老说的是。”
content_en:
Yunhang Town is located among the peaks. Due to the mountainous terrain, the area is very wide. Even though the permanent population is nearly 100,000, the per capita area is very large.

    The town is divided into eighteen districts, with eighty-one main streets, plus countless lanes, paths, bluestone roads, and criss-crossing streets.

    West Street is not a street name, but refers to the ‘West Street District’, which is one of the core areas of Zongmenfang City. There is a third-level spiritual vein underground, which was later transplanted by the sect.

    Most of the residents in this area are relatives of the Qingyun Sect members. Even the disciples of the sect have come to buy houses here for more private residences. Of course, they are mainly elders.

    It is relatively rare for people like Lin Yushan to first become Nie Wuji's concubine and then join the sect.

    After all, the sect has many rules and regulations, and there is not so much freedom, such as points tasks. As long as you join the sect and become a disciple, no matter whether you are the wife or concubine of the peak master or the son or daughter of an elder, you must complete the prescribed points tasks.

    At this moment, the sky was covered with dark clouds and it seemed like it was going to rain.

    Qi Zizuo drove the rainbow and landed in front of the gate of a mansion.

    Qi Yunxi was carrying Su Mu on his back, and the two of them looked up. There was no plaque on the door, only the instructions "West Block, No. 6 Baochang Street" engraved on the eaves and corners.

    "This is it."

    Qi Zi Zhuo said something, stepped forward to unlock the door and pushed it in. He led the way and introduced the general situation of the house.

    The house here is a three-entry courtyard, covering an area of ​​nearly four acres, with a total of forty-nine rooms, including nine training rooms. It is equipped with second-level spirit gathering formations. There are also many formations such as concealment, isolation, defense, and attack, all of which are second-level.

    As you move forward, you will see big trees, shrubs, lawns, flower beds, wells, ponds, rockeries, pavilions... one by one, and the environment is elegant and quiet.

    Qi Yunxi looked around, her beautiful eyes shining brightly, a smile on her lips, and her joy was beyond words.

    Even Su Mu's heart was stirred up, and he couldn't help asking: "Mr. Qi, how many years have you rented this house?"

    As a member of the Qingyun Sect, he has some understanding of various aspects of the city. He knows that the West Block is a long-term residential area, with rent starting from at least ten years.

    Qi Zizhuo turned his head to look at it and said with a smile: "I bought it and got the right of permanent residence."

    Hearing this, the corner of Su Mu's mouth twitched slightly, but the first thought that came to his mind was: How much wealth can be left after buying such a house?

    Qi Yunxi was filled with joy, her eyelashes trembled, and she thought to herself: Only when you buy it can you consider your real home.

    The three of them went all the way to the master bedroom of the main building in the inner courtyard.

    Qi Yunxi carefully placed Su Mu on the large bed and scanned the room. Except for tables, chairs, cabinets and other furniture, no other items had been added yet. The branches and leaves of an old osmanthus tree reached out to the window and swayed gently in the afternoon breeze, casting tiny spots of light on the window sill.

    Qi Zizuo looked around and said, "Whatever you need, you can take care of it yourself in the future."

    He took a chair and sat in front of the bed. A smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, as if he had guessed Su Mu's psychology, and said:

    "Don't be short-sighted. If you obtain the ownership of the property, you can live there forever. In the future, you can have children and reproduce and take root in Yunhang Town. As long as the sect is not broken, there will be sufficient security."

    Su Mu naturally understands this truth, but he knows his own situation well. He may not be able to stay in Qingyun Sect forever. If he encounters trouble that cannot be solved, he will definitely run away.

    A trace of embarrassment flashed across his face, and he said with shame: "That's what Mr. Qi said."
